changeSet.sql: ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAssetHierarchy] ( @ID int, @Type varchar(50) ) AS Begin -- declare @ID int =2430947 ;--4832;-- 16113; --declare @Type varchar(50) ='FusionAttribute';--'Taxonomy'; --'Artifact' if @Type = 'Artifact' begin with Sub as ( select O.ObjectID as ID, PA.ObjectID as ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail O cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ObjectID) as D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(O.ID) P left join Asset PA on PA.ID = P.ID where O.ObjectID = @ID and O.Object = 'Artifact' union all select O.ObjectID as ID, PA.ObjectID as ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, C.[Level] + 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail O inner join Sub as C on C.ParentID = O.ObjectID cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ObjectID) as D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(O.ObjectID) P outer apply ( select * from Asset where ID = P.ID ) PA where O.Object = 'Artifact' and (P.ID is null or (PA.ID = P.ID)) ) select ID, ParentID,[Path],LevelName,Url,rank() over (Order by Level desc) as [Level] from Sub; end else if @Type = 'Taxonomy' begin with Sub as ( select O.ObjectID as ID, PA.ObjectID as ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail O cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ObjectID) as D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(O.ID) P left join Asset PA on PA.ID = P.ID where O.ObjectID = @ID and O.Object = 'Taxonomy' union all select O.ObjectID as ID, PA.ObjectID as ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, C.[Level] + 1 as [Level] from AssetDetail O inner join Sub as C on C.ParentID = O.ObjectID cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ObjectID) as D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(O.ID) P outer apply ( select * from Asset where ID = P.ID ) PA where O.Object = 'Taxonomy' and (P.ID is null or (PA.ID = P.ID)) ) select ID, ParentID,[Path],LevelName,Url,rank() over (Order by Level desc) as [Level] from Sub end else if @Type = 'FusionAttribute' begin with Sub as ( select O.ID, O.ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, 1 as [Level] from FusionAttribute O cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ID) as D where O.ID = @ID union all select O.ID, O.ParentID, D.TextPath as TextPath, D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, C.[Level] + 1 as [Level] from FusionAttribute O inner join Sub as C on C.ParentID = O.ID cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ID) as D ) select ID, ParentID,[Path],LevelName,Url,rank() over (Order by Level desc) as [Level] from Sub; end end

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAssetHierarchy] ( @ID int, @Type varchar(50) ) AS Begin
if @Type = 'Artifact' begin with Sub as ( select O.ID, O.ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, 1 as [Level] from Artifact O cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ID) as D where O.ID = @ID union all select O.ID, O.ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, C.[Level] + 1 as [Level] from Artifact O inner join Sub as C on C.ParentID = O.ID cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ID) as D ) select ID, ParentID,[Path],LevelName,Url,rank() over (Order by Level desc) as [Level] from Sub; end else if @Type = 'Taxonomy' begin with Sub as ( select O.ID, O.ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, 1 as [Level] from [Taxonomy] O cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ID) as D where O.ID = @ID union all select O.ID, O.ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, C.[Level] + 1 as [Level] from [Taxonomy] O inner join Sub as C on C.ParentID = O.ID cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ID) as D ) select ID, ParentID,[Path],LevelName,Url,rank() over (Order by Level desc) as [Level] from Sub; end else if @Type = 'FusionAttribute' begin with Sub as ( select O.ID, O.ParentID, D.TextPath as [Path], D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, 1 as [Level] from FusionAttribute O cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ID) as D where O.ID = @ID union all select O.ID, O.ParentID, D.TextPath as TextPath, D.TypeName as LevelName, D.Url as Url, C.[Level] + 1 as [Level] from FusionAttribute O inner join Sub as C on C.ParentID = O.ID cross apply [utility].[ObjectDetail](@Type,O.ID) as D ) select ID, ParentID,[Path],LevelName,Url,rank() over (Order by Level desc) as [Level] from Sub; end end
